Task / step: T1.1 Walk-around inspection with the mechanical supports fitted
Cause: Pressure retained in accumulators or trapped lines
Effect: Fluid injection or whip injury to the inspector
Controls: Zero-energy check before contact; supports fitted

Task / step: T1.2 Energise power and run the self-test
Cause: Battery or fuel fault present at start-up
Effect: Fire near the pilot station
Controls: Self-test of battery and fuel systems before ingress

Task / step: T1.3 Climb the fold-down ladder into the kneeling pod
Cause: Leg motion enabled while the pilot is on the ladder
Effect: Pilot caught or thrown off by moving structure
Controls: Motion inhibited until readiness is confirmed; ladder interlocked against walking

Task / step: T1.4 Climb the ladder or sill with the walker still
Cause: Slip or misstep on the ladder or the 0.62 m sill
Effect: Fall of about 1 to 1.6 m during normal ingress
Controls: Three points of contact (grab handles); non-slip treads
Note: No hazard record for a fall during normal ingress or egress; HAZ-PIL-003 covers only the emergency exit

Task / step: T1.5 Fasten the restraint and confirm readiness
Cause: Readiness reported with restraint, hatch or controls not ready
Effect: Motion enabled with the pilot unrestrained
Controls: Readiness interlock

Task / step: T1.6 Rise from the kneel to standing
Cause: Person inside the folding zone of the pod and legs
Effect: Person under the pod or beside the legs crushed
Controls: Clear zone confirmed by the observer before rising

Task / step: T2.1 Confirm the exclusion zone and the arms stowed
Cause: Walking enabled with the arms out or a person in reach
Effect: Person struck by the claws
Controls: Arm stow interlock; observer with an independent stop

Task / step: T2.2 Walk on prepared ground within the slope limit
Cause: Terrain, slope or a feedback fault beyond the envelope
Effect: Fall or runaway motion with the pilot aboard
Controls: Stability envelope protection; feedback fault detection

Task / step: T2.3 Stop on command or by protective stop
Cause: Stop does not reach a safe state, or support is lost on stopping
Effect: Collapse or uncontrolled drop of the cockpit
Controls: Independent protective stop; fail-safe load holding

Task / step: T3.1 Approach and grip the load with the zone confirmed clear
Cause: Arm moves before the zone is clear
Effect: Crew member struck or pinned
Controls: Manipulation inhibited until the zone is confirmed clear

Task / step: T3.2 Crew guide the load near the claws
Cause: Crew inside the arms' reach by working method
Effect: Crew member struck or pinned
Controls: Taglines from outside the reach, if crew guidance is allowed at all
Note: Decide whether any crew task may be inside the arms' reach (SYS-017 exclusion-zone TBD)

Task / step: T3.3 Carry the load while walking
Cause: Load swing, grip failure or a centre-of-mass shift
Effect: Load strikes a person or upsets the walker
Controls: Loaded-walking limits and carry pose; exclusion zone for a loaded walker

Task / step: T3.4 Set the load down
Cause: Load released before it rests
Effect: Load falls onto crew
Controls: Release only with the load confirmed resting

Task / step: T4.1 Pre-flight at the dock with crew handling the UAV
Cause: Rotor start or energised contacts while crew handle the aircraft
Effect: Rotor strike or electric shock
Controls: Docked rotor inhibit; contacts de-energised for handling

Task / step: T4.2 Launch from the dock
Cause: Launch outside the envelope or with charging on
Effect: Rotor or airframe strike; arcing at the connector
Controls: Launch permit requires a stationary walker and charging off

Task / step: T4.3 Pilot uses UAV imagery while walking
Cause: Misleading or stale imagery shown as valid
Effect: Walker steered toward an unseen person
Controls: Validity and staleness annunciation; imagery advisory only

Task / step: T5.1 Recovery approach and capture
Cause: Approach to a moving or unready dock; false retained state
Effect: Collision or the aircraft thrown off the walker
Controls: Recovery permit; positive retention sensing

Task / step: T5.2 Charge the UAV on the dock
Cause: Overcharge or a damaged battery
Effect: Battery fire behind the pod
Controls: Independent charge cut-offs; fire-separated dock

Task / step: T5.3 Remove the UAV or its battery by hand
Cause: Charging or arming not isolated before handling
Effect: Electric shock or rotor strike
Controls: Isolate charging and confirm the rotor inhibit before handling

Task / step: T6.1 Lower to the kneel
Cause: Person in the folding zone; lowering fault
Effect: Crush under the pod; pilot unable to leave normally
Controls: Clear zone before lowering; side-hatch emergency exit

Task / step: T6.2 Unfasten and climb down the ladder
Cause: Motion enabled before the pilot is clear
Effect: Pilot caught by moving structure
Controls: Motion inhibited until the pilot is clear and the ladder stowed

Task / step: T6.3 Isolate energy and fit the supports
Cause: Stored pressure left in the system
Effect: Injection or crush injury after shutdown
Controls: Stored-energy isolation and zero-energy verification

Task / step: T7.1 Work on hydraulic lines and actuators
Cause: Residual pressure
Effect: Fluid injection or actuator motion
Controls: Lock-out, bleed-down and gauge-verified zero energy

Task / step: T7.2 Service the traction battery
Cause: Damaged cell or short during handling
Effect: Thermal runaway or burns
Controls: Independent battery isolation

Task / step: T7.3 Refuel the engine-generator (power alternative B)
Cause: Spill or vapour near a hot surface
Effect: Fuel fire
Controls: Engine off and cool; fuel shut-off

Task / step: T7.4 Work at height on the pod, dock or roll bar
Cause: Slip or loss of balance on the walker, 3 to 4.5 m up
Effect: Fall from height
Controls: Access platform and fall arrest (TBD)
Note: No hazard record for a fall from height during maintenance

Task / step: T7.5 Function test after maintenance, walker supported
Cause: Unexpected motion or pressure while crew are close
Effect: Crew caught by moving structure or fluid injection
Controls: Supports fitted; motion enable only with crew clear

Task / step: T8.1 Emergency egress through a side hatch
Cause: Descent from about 3.2 m without power or the kneel
Effect: Fall injury to the pilot
Controls: Shoulder step, davit ladder and fall arrest

Task / step: T8.2 Crew extract an incapacitated pilot
Cause: Pilot cannot leave unaided; walker standing or fallen
Effect: Delayed extraction; injury to the pilot or the rescuers
Controls: Extraction procedure and equipment (TBD)
Note: No hazard record for extraction of an incapacitated pilot (SCN-104)
